storyTitle: Just 1,099 of 2,821 NSE stocks trade above their December 2025 closing levels despite this month's rally
insight: Nifty is surging, yet only 1,099 of 2,821 NSE stocks sit above their year-end 2025 close: the rally is carried by a few names.
linkedin:
Nifty is up sharply in November. Most Indian stocks are still down for the year.

As of November 16, only 1,099 of 2,821 NSE-listed stocks were trading above their December 31, 2025 closing levels, per ACE Equity data cited by Business Standard. That is about 39%, even after this month's rally.

So the headline index and the typical stock are telling two different stories. The rally has been carried by a relatively small set of names.

It matters on a day like this one. Wall Street's AI and chip stocks just sold off hard, with the Nasdaq in correction territory, and Nvidia reports tonight with Anthropic pricing its IPO tomorrow. GIFT Nifty is barely moving. That calm may say less about resilience and more about how few stocks are holding up the index.

If you invest, check what your portfolio owns, not just where the index closed. If you build or lead a business, remember that a strong index is not the same as strong demand across the market. 📊
